description: The same event search as search_events, plus what each event is trading at on XP: its all-in get-in price per ticket and how many fan listings are open to offers on it -- 'tickets to the season opener', 'seats near me under $100'. Suits questions where price is part of the ask; search_events suits finding an event. The fan listings themselves are in list_open_listings.

cbsa.description: Metro area filter (synonyms: city, near me, area).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

max_date.description: Filter events on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'next month', resolve against _meta.context.today.

min_date.description: Filter events on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'this weekend', resolve against _meta.context.today.

name: search_market
title: Search the Market
